name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, JUNE 17, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Council Member Mosca regarding San Diego Community Power.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Public comments regarding items not listed on this agenda (oral communications) must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR Public comments regarding consent calendar items on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov.
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Acting Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-06-17 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Cooperation and Administrative Services Agreement between the City of Encinitas and San Diego Community Power. Contact Person: Human Resources Director Bokosky
Authorize the Interim City Manager to execute the Cooperation and Administrative Agreement by and between San Diego Community Power and the City of Encinitas for the period of May 1, 2020 through December 31, 2020 for human resources and other services.
2020-06-17 Item 08B San Diego Community Power Agreement
8C.
Resolution 2020-45, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing All-Way Stop Control at Multiple Locations Throughout the City.” Contact Person: Engineering Specialist Barr
Adopt City Council Resolution 2020-45, “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing All-Way Stop Control at Multiple Locations throughout the City.”
2020-06-17 Item 08C All Way Traffic Control
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public comments regarding Action Items listed on this agenda must be submitted via email to clerk@encinitasca.gov
Comments received by 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and read into the record at the meeting for up to three minutes or in accordance with the time period established by the Mayor/Chair.
Comments received after 3:00 p.m. on the day of the meeting will be provided to the City Council and made a part of the meeting record.
10A.
Consideration of resolutions calling a General Municipal Election and requesting the County Board of Supervisors to consolidate the City’s General Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-34, calling a General Municipal Election to be held Tuesday, November 3, 2020; 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2020-35, requesting the County Board of Supervisors to consolidate the City’s General Municipal Election with the Statewide General Election; 3) Direct the City Attorney to prepare an impartial analysis for the voter pamphlet of up to 500 words for the ballot measure; and 4) Determine if the Council wishes to take an official position on the initiative and if a Council subcommittee should be appointed to author an argument against the measure.
2020-06-17 Item 10A Calling and Consolidating the November 2020 Election
10B.
City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2020-21. Contact Person: Arts Program Administrator Gilliam
Review and approve the evaluation panel’s recommended funding allocations and make any desired additional allocations to the grant applicants.
2020-06-17 Item 10B City of Encinitas Community Grant Program Application Requests for FY 2020-21 - Final for X
10C.
Temporary suspension of local permit restrictions on ABC licensed alcohol serving
establishments authorizing expansion of service areas and off-site sales of alcoholic services subject to conditions. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa’u
Approve Resolution No. 2020-53.
2020-06-17 Item 10C Alcohol Regulations Agenda Report
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JUNE 24, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
